name: @pipeworx/mcp-nyc-parks

tools.name: events
tools.description: Upcoming NYC Parks events (next ~14 days): free/low-cost outdoor, fitness, nature, kids and recreation-center programming. Filter by date window, category (e.g. "Best for Kids", "Sports", "Nature", "Fitness"), and keyword (title/park/location/description).

to.description: Latest event date YYYY-MM-DD (default: no upper bound within the 14-day feed).

category.description: Filter by a category keyword, e.g. "Best for Kids", "Sports", "Nature", "Fitness", "Free". Discover via the categories tool.

query.description: Keyword over title, park name, location, and description.

tools.name: categories
tools.description: List the categories used across NYC Parks events (with counts) — filterable facets like "Best for Kids", "Sports", "Nature Exploration", "Fitness".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nyc-parks forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nyc-parks pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
